function.name: tool_launch_browser
function.description: Launches a live browser instance and navigates to the target application URL for visual tracking.

url.description: The absolute HTTP/HTTPS URL of the application under test.

function.name: tool_inspect_dom
function.description: Scans the live DOM tree of the current active browser page and returns matching elements based on text, placeholder, test-id, or tag attributes.

semantic_hint.description: A descriptive label, partial text, or key identifying the failed element (e.g., 'login', 'submit', 'username').

function.name: tool_edit_page_object
function.description: Programmatically updates a specific selector string variable inside a designated Page Object Model (POM) Python file.

filename.description: The exact target file name within the pages directory (e.g., 'login_page.py').

target_var.description: The specific variable string property to modify (e.g., 'username_selector').

corrected_selector.description: The new valid CSS selector, XPath, or data attribute string string (e.g., '[data-test="username"]').
